preconditions.description: The number of queries must be between 1 and 10.
The number of nodes in each graph must be between 2 and 1000.
The number of edges must be at least 1 and at most the maximum number of edges in an undirected graph.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints must be valid node numbers within the range of 1 to n.
The starting node must be a valid node number within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n-1 distances corresponding to nodes other than the start node.

postconditions.expression: all(int(distance) == -1 or int(distance) % 6 == 0 for distance in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each distance must either be -1 for unreachable nodes or a multiple of 6 for reachable nodes.
All distances must be non-negative or -1 for unreachable nodes.
